author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: The legal audit has confirmed that our current consent records for loyalty basket data are invalid. Until we establish a solid legal basis, this data cannot touch the forecast pipeline. I am mandating that every data contract must carry a formal sign off before it is activated. This is a hard requirement for our governance framework. I will not approve any workflow that allows personal data to flow without that explicit, documented approval. Please ensure the team understands this is not a suggestion or a target for future improvement. It is the baseline for compliance. If a contract lacks that sign off, it must be rejected immediately.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly defines a hard requirement and refusal line, stating that any workflow allowing personal data to flow without documented approval will be rejected, which constitutes a boundary that cannot be crossed.
